channel.title: Medics Musings: FDA recall roundup
channel.description: FDA drug, device and food recalls from the last 30 days, updated weekly from openFDA.

item.title: Class I device recall: Tandem Mobi Insulin Pump, Models: 1004004, 1010750, 1012676, 1012719, 1013655, 1013656, 10 (Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc.)
item.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. ( Tandem ) has identified that certain Tandem Mobi insulin pumps may generate false-positive occlusion alarms when no actual insulin flow obstruction is present. Investigation determined that… Recalling firm: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc.. Status: Ongoing.
